member.name: T:YANum.Core.Complex32
member.summary: A single-precision complex number: two components, exactly 8 bytes, sequentially laid out with no padding.

remarks.para: .NET ships only the double-precision , so YANum supplies this type to back the Complex64 dtype. The byte image is the little-endian concatenation of then , which is what NumPy's complex64 stores.
Equality is IEEE on both components: a value with a NaN component is not equal to itself, matching . There is no ordering.

The static members Sqrt, Exp, Log and Pow follow the FSharp.Core naming convention, so F#'s built-in sqrt, exp, log and ( ** ) work directly on this type. Abs returns a magnitude (as Complex.Abs does), so F#'s abs, whose signature is ^T -> ^T, deliberately does not resolve against it.
